claim_text: The September 13, 2022 Farah superseding indictment, No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57) paras 22 and 37, alleges that ThinkTechAct / Mind Foundry received more than $18 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds from Sponsor A and another $3.7 million from Feeding Our Future between in or about February 2021 and January 2022, based on claims of serving more than 25,000 children a day. Para 40 recites that ThinkTechAct transferred more than 70 percent of the $21 million it received to Empire Cuisine and Market and related entities. Face language is received (amount_paid). The $18 million, $3.7 million, and $21 million are components of one ThinkTechAct receipt figure and a subset of the $40 million Empire-group alleged_loss; they must not be summed with each other, with Empire $28 million, with Bock $250 million, with HSS, or with Mohamed $12 million.

supporting_passages.quote: In all, between in or about February 2021 and January 2022, ThinkTechAct received more than $18 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds from Sponsor A and another $3.7 million from Feeding Our Future.
ThinkTechAct transferred more than 70 percent of the $21 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds it received to Empire Cuisine and Market and related entities.

amounts.methodology: Para 22: more than $18 million from Sponsor A. Component of para 40 $21 million.
Para 22: $3.7 million from Feeding Our Future. Component of para 40 $21 million. Distinct from FOF's $18 million 2021 admin-fee recital.
Para 40 rounds $18M+$3.7M to $21 million. Not independent.

qualifiers: ThinkTechAct $18M from Sponsor A is not the FOF $18M admin-fee recital
subset of empire-22cr124-40m-scheme; inflows also overlap Empire $28M
do not add to Bock $250M, HSS, or Mohamed $12M
